name: Bűnös Világ
source: The protagonist doesn't have any friends, thus he spends all his free time on the computer, watching anime. But eventually got bored of it, so to make his life a bit more exciting, he's starting to kill his family...
translation: 主角没有朋友，所以他所有的空闲时间都在电脑上看动漫。但最终厌倦了，所以为了让他的生活更刺激一点，他开始杀死他的家人……
